lines.en: My five arms inch forward one by one.
I grip the sand with my tube feet.
The rock is slick, so I press down harder.

lines.zh: 从沙滩爬到浅水，用了半天。
lines.en: Beach to shallows took me half a day.

lines.zh: 海底的沙，从我腕下滑过。
lines.en: The seabed sand slides beneath my arms.
I creep along slowly and never halt.

lines.zh: 一条腕探路，另外四条跟上。
lines.en: One arm leads and the other four follow.

lines.zh: 海沟的坡太陡，我绕着走。
lines.en: The trench slope is steep, so I go around.

lines.zh: 我贴着礁石挪，风浪推不动。
lines.en: Waves cannot shift me while I hug this rock.

lines.zh: 沙里埋着贝壳，我翻过去。
lines.en: A shell lies buried; I creep over it.

lines.zh: 我的腕弯了一下，继续爬。
lines.en: One arm bends, and I keep crawling on.
Deep sea sand is fine and silent underfoot.

lines.zh: 我从石缝里挤出去，慢得很。
lines.en: I squeeze from the crack, painfully slow.
The tide is out; I shift to wetter sand.

lines.zh: 我把一条腕伸出去，再收回来。
lines.en: I stretch one arm out, then pull it back.

lines.zh: 沙粒卡在管足里，我抖一抖。
lines.en: Sand catches in my tube feet; I shake it loose.

lines.zh: 这道石缝的宽度，刚好够我。
lines.en: This crack is just wide enough for me.

lines.zh: 我翻了半个身，继续往前。
lines.en: I roll half over and keep going.
I lie spread on the sand like a star.
Water passes over my arms, very lightly.
A little crab crawls over my back.

lines.zh: 太阳走完一圈，我挪半臂。
lines.en: The sun crosses the sky; I move half an arm.
Sand has buried half of my body.

lines.zh: 深海很静，我听得见自己。
lines.en: The deep is so quiet I hear myself.

lines.zh: 我张开腕，让水从缝里过。
lines.en: I spread my arms to let water through.
Seagrass sways right beside me.
I chase nobody, and could catch nobody.

lines.zh: 背上的水干了，我又沉下去。
lines.en: My back dries out, so I sink lower again.
The rock crevice is cool and I stay.
Something touches me and I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我把自己晒成沙的颜色。
lines.en: I have baked myself the color of sand.
Waves come and go; I have not moved.
The sand you stand on belongs to me.
I have one point of life; do not touch me.
You bend down and your shadow covers me.

lines.zh: 我看不见上面，只看见脚。
lines.en: I cannot see up there, only your feet.
Why grab me? I am not worth eating.
Your finger is thicker than any of my arms.

lines.zh: 我在沙滩上，谁都看得见。
lines.en: Out on the beach, anyone can spot me.
Each step you take shakes the sand.

lines.zh: 我推不动，你也推不动我。
lines.en: I cannot push you, and you cannot push me.
Move along; I still have sand to bask on.
A split has opened across my body.
An arm is gone; it will grow back.
I have only one life point; no more hits.
Pressed into the sand, I slowly push up.
It hurts, but I still cannot be moved.
My split soaks in water and its edge pales.
I pull my arms in to guard my middle.
One more blow and I am finished.
I hold the stone and refuse to let go.

lines.zh: 谁来都推不动我，但会疼。
lines.en: None can push me, but it still hurts.
I cannot manage anything this large.

lines.zh: 碎屑落在沙上，我慢慢挪。
lines.en: Crumbs fall on the sand; I creep over slowly.
It smells of something, but I am not hungry.
Do not press the food onto my face.
Moving once takes me a long while.
I can simply cover that little bit.

lines.zh: 我没有嘴去抢，你放地上。
lines.en: I have no mouth to snatch with; set it down.
The seawater has washed the smell away.
Wait until it settles, then I will go.
You hold it so high I cannot reach.
You pushed me and I did not budge.

lines.zh: 我吸在石头上，拔不下来。
lines.en: I am stuck to the stone and will not come off.
Your toe caught me and I curled a little.
Full knockback resistance: I cannot be moved.
I stayed put, and you stepped back.
The sand sinks where you stepped.
All five of my arms have gone rigid.

lines.zh: 撞吧，我贴着海底长住了。
lines.en: Bump away; I am rooted to this seabed.

lines.zh: 你力气大，可我用不上劲。
lines.en: You are strong, but I have no strength to spend.

lines.zh: 别踩第二下，我就一条命。
lines.en: No second step; I only have one life point.
We lie side by side stuck to the reef.

lines.zh: 两条腕碰在一起，算答应了。
lines.en: Two arms touch, and that counts as yes.
I raise one arm and wave it slowly.
Another star lies on the sand nearby.
Neither of us moves, but we are close.

lines.zh: 深海里的婚事，没有声音。
lines.en: A deep sea wedding makes no sound at all.
I stretch one arm toward its arm.
The tide will pull the covers over us.
Afterwards we part and crawl off slowly.
Many stars in the sea; I know only this one.
I curl an arm around a piece of shell.
I drag this little thing along with me.
A bright flake in the sand; I cover it.
Picking it up is useless, but I still do.
I slowly gather my arms to hold it.
It is too heavy, so I give up.
This shell belongs to my patch of reef.

lines.zh: 我压在它上面，谁也拿不走。
lines.en: I lie on top; nobody can take it now.
Picking things up tires me more than crawling.
I tuck it under an arm until tomorrow.
Something stirred in the sand.

lines.zh: 我看不清，但知道有东西。
lines.en: I cannot see it, but something is there.
It is too close, so I draw my arms in.
The shell is moving, so meat is inside.
I have no teeth, so I can only wait.
A shadow on the seabed drifts closer.
That thing stepped on one of my arms.
I will not chase; it will leave by itself.
Moving means being seen, so I stay still.
A little pain, but not on me yet.
I fix on the shape of its shadow.
It halts, and my arms halt with it.
I slowly reach one arm toward it.
The ripples changed; it is coming.
I press to the sand and wait it out.
It went around me, and I relaxed.
My arms tighten by slow degrees.
It is stepping down a second time.
I will only get a single chance.
The light dims; it has probably gone.
I cannot hurt anyone; I can only cling.
An arm lands on its foot and slides off.
It lifts its foot and I am peeled off.
My strength is like wind over sand.
I cling and wait for it to fall over.
It steps on me; I press right back.

lines.zh: 一条腕被扯断了，还活着。
lines.en: One arm is torn off; I am still alive.
I stick to the top of its foot.
If I cannot win, I pretend to be stone.

lines.zh: 命只有一点，我打得很省。
lines.en: With one life point, I fight very carefully.
I turn myself out of the sand.
My five arms open and slowly flatten out.

lines.zh: 海沟底下，我先贴住石头。
lines.en: At the trench floor I first cling to stone.
The deep sea sand is very cold.
I land on the beach and bask there.
A wave shoves me up onto the shallow shelf.
Another star beside me has just woken.
First I spread my arms wide open.
There is no rock pressing down on me here.
One point of life, and it is enough.
The fire curls the tips of my arms.
After the fall I lie even flatter.
I soak in water; how is that drowning?

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，五腕朝上。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over, five arms to the sky.
An arrow pins me down to the sand.
A numbness spreads and my arms go stiff.

lines.zh: 我很久没吃东西，腕细了。
lines.en: I have not eaten and my arms grew thin.
The water whitens and I clench all over.
I sink and even the sand is gone.
